_comment:
DYST config template - ALL possible keys with hints.
  GLOBAL (config.json only): Core loop, Media, Playback & audio, Display, Chroma key, System & misc.
  PER-FILE (media sidecar .json/.txt): Display + Playback + Media keys + weight, chroma, chroma_key.
  Later wins; bad values are dropped with a warning (never fatal).

_hints.odds: 1 in N chance per tick (must be >= 1). Default 1000 = 0.1% per tick.
_hints.max_concurrent: max overlays playing at once; 0 = unlimited. Default 3.
_hints.reroll_in_same_tick: on a success, re-roll immediately within the same tick (burst). Locked true in v1. Default true.
_hints.media_folder: relative path (from app dir) to the media root. Default 'media'. Subfolders media/images/ and media/videos/ are scanned; sidecar audio + settings live in the same subfolder.
_hints.image_display_seconds: PER-FILE only (media sidecar, NOT config.json): PER-FILE how long THIS image stays up (seconds). Videos ignore.
_hints.fade_out_seconds: PER-FILE only (media sidecar, NOT config.json): PER-FILE fade-out for THIS media (seconds). Renamed from 'fade_seconds'.
_hints.fade_in_seconds: PER-FILE only (media sidecar, NOT config.json): PER-FILE fade-in (seconds): fades in before display clock starts. Images/GIFs only; videos ignore.
_hints.max_duration: PER-FILE only (media sidecar, NOT config.json): PER-FILE hard cap (seconds; 0 = no cap) for THIS media + its audio. When it fires, media and audio STOP INSTANTLY, NO fade-out. Per-file wins over global.
_hints.speed: PER-FILE only (media sidecar, NOT config.json): PER-FILE playback speed multiplier (>0). Scales media + audio + image display + fades (1/speed).
_hints.pitch: PER-FILE only (media sidecar, NOT config.json): PER-FILE audio pitch multiplier (>0). Sidecar + video audio re-encoded via ffmpeg. Independent of speed.
_hints.speed_pitch: PER-FILE only (media sidecar, NOT config.json): PER-FILE combined speed+pitch (>0): OVERRIDES per-file/global speed and pitch (sets both). 0 = use them individually.
_hints.volume: PER-FILE only (media sidecar, NOT config.json): PER-FILE audio volume 0.0-1.0 for THIS media (overrides global).
_hints.mode: PER-FILE only (media sidecar, NOT config.json): how this media covers the screen: fit | stretch | cover-height | cover-width | custom. Per-file wins over global mode.
_hints.opacity: PER-FILE only (media sidecar, NOT config.json): this media's overlay transparency 0.0-1.0. Default 1.0.
_hints.position_x: PER-FILE only (media sidecar, NOT config.json): custom-mode only: X position -1..2 for THIS media (0 = left edge, 1 = right, 0.5 = centered; outside 0..1 pushes off-screen).
_hints.position_y: PER-FILE only (media sidecar, NOT config.json): custom-mode only: Y position -1..2 for THIS media.
_hints.scale_x: PER-FILE only (media sidecar, NOT config.json): custom-mode only: width multiplier relative to the 'fit' size for THIS media.
_hints.scale_y: PER-FILE only (media sidecar, NOT config.json): custom-mode only: height multiplier relative to the 'fit' size for THIS media.
_hints.scale: PER-FILE only (media sidecar, NOT config.json): custom-mode only (per-file): uniform scale for BOTH axes for THIS media (e.g. '0.5~1.5' = one shared random draw). Overwritten when scale_x AND scale_y are both given.
_hints.flip_h: PER-FILE only (media sidecar, NOT config.json): custom-mode only: mirror THIS media horizontally.
_hints.flip_v: PER-FILE only (media sidecar, NOT config.json): custom-mode only: mirror THIS media vertically.
_hints.rotation: PER-FILE only (media sidecar, NOT config.json): custom-mode only: rotation in degrees for THIS media (around its center).
_hints.chroma_key: PER-FILE only (media sidecar, NOT config.json): PER-FILE PRESET string (green/blue/weak/strong): THIS file uses this chroma key independent of the global 'chroma_key'. Only takes effect with 'chroma': true (false always wins). Same preset names as global; cache invalidates on preset change.
_hints.monitor: which monitor: 'primary' or a 0-based monitor index. Default 'primary'.
_hints.autostart: true = register Windows Run key on every launch (auto-starts at login, silent). false + boot launch (Run key present + --autostart flag) = remove key and exit immediately. false + manual launch = clear stale key, keep running.
_hints.debug: verbose logging to app.log. Default false.
_hints.show_console: true = launch with a visible log terminal; false = hidden background (default). When false on Windows + frozen, the console is detached after config load.
_hints.download_max_height: max video height (px) for the downloader (scripts/download_videos.py). Default 1080.
_hints.rescan_seconds: interval (seconds) for auto-rescanning the media folder for new/removed files. Default 60.
_hints.weight: PER-FILE only (media sidecar, NOT config.json): PER-FILE pick probability (>= 0; floats; default 1). 2 = twice as likely, 0.5 = half. Chance = weight/total_weight. 0 = never picked (warning logged). Works in ANY mode.
_hints.chroma: PER-FILE only (media sidecar, NOT config.json): PER-FILE true/false override of the global chroma-key flag: true = filter THIS file, false = skip even when global chroma is on (files with real alpha). Default true.

_hints_deprecated: OLD/REMOVED keys: per-file 'chroma' was previously the only override (now 'chroma' boolean gates on/off and 'chroma_key' is a per-file PRESET string); global 'cover' mode was removed (falls back to 'fit'); 'fade_seconds' renamed to 'fade_out_seconds' (old name still accepted as deprecated alias).
